authorizedRecoverySlice.purpose: Restore the canonical authenticated admission control required by the governing architecture.
allowedWork: continue repository-only acceptance-contract repair without inspecting MAST content or evaluator material
test the admission endpoint, authenticated producer binding, fail-closed client, and exact source-receipt binding
reconcile the live Mission Control checkout with the canonical implementation
deploy only the narrow verified control-plane recovery revision
verify deployed runtime identity against that exact revision
forbiddenWork: dispatch MAST sequence 15 or later before live admission succeeds
use a mock, fabricated response, hard-coded allow, bypass, or direct database edit as admission evidence
treat repository tests as live admission evidence
alter frozen MAST inputs, order, families, gates, prompts, or methodology
ask the owner to relay or confirm an internal packet
